title: Batch-onboard local models to the cloud and register each one: verify by document state, handle posted-command dialogs
use_when: An agent uploads or registers a series of local models to one cloud project folder
A bridge call outlasts the bridge's reply wait (cloud save, enable worksharing, sync)
An add-in command started by PostCommand opens file pickers, confirmation prompts or result dialogs
Some models may already exist in the cloud folder, uploaded earlier by someone else
not_for: Single interactive uploads done by a person
Batch tools that already run headless without dialogs: use those and skip the screen handling

environment.desktop: screenshots, mouse and keyboard for add-in dialogs
environment.model: 13 per-building models of one campus, cloud project folder
environment.batch_tool: ZEN 1.2 (Federation > Cloud GUIDs, Model Registry CSV)

changelog.change: First recorded (IN-0015, PR #6; onboarding iteration of IN-0014, PR #5)
Batch tool named: ZEN 1.2 (Cloud GUIDs writes the registry row; owner decision IN-0023)
